WITH payment_rows AS (
    SELECT p.order_id,
           COUNT(*) AS n,
           COUNT(p.payment_value) AS n_values,
           MAX(ABS(p.payment_value * 100 - ROUND(p.payment_value * 100))) AS cent_error
    FROM main.order_payments AS p
    GROUP BY p.order_id
),
item_rows AS (
    SELECT i.order_id, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM main.order_items AS i
    GROUP BY i.order_id
),
delivered AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_purchase_timestamp, c.customer_unique_id,
           p.n AS payment_count, p.n_values, p.cent_error, i.n AS item_count
    FROM main.orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN main.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN payment_rows AS p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
    LEFT JOIN item_rows AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS joined_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS distinct_customers,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered') AS delivered_headers,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_unique_id FROM delivered GROUP BY customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 1)) AS single_order_customers,
       SUM(customer_unique_id IS NULL OR customer_unique_id = '') AS missing_customer_keys,
       SUM(julianday(order_purchase_timestamp) IS NULL) AS missing_purchase_times,
       MIN(order_purchase_timestamp) AS earliest_purchase,
       MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS latest_purchase,
       SUM(payment_count IS NULL) AS orders_without_payment_rows,
       SUM(n_values < payment_count) AS orders_with_null_payment_amounts,
       SUM(payment_count > 1) AS orders_with_multiple_payments,
       SUM(item_count IS NULL) AS orders_without_items,
       MAX(cent_error) AS max_payment_cent_error
FROM delivered

WITH order_payments AS (
    SELECT p.order_id,
           SUM(CAST(ROUND(p.payment_value * 100) AS INTEGER)) AS paid_cents
    FROM main.order_payments AS p
    GROUP BY p.order_id
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
           MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS last_purchase,
           COUNT(*) AS order_count,
           -- A missing order payment leaves the customer's total spend unknown.
           CASE WHEN COUNT(p.paid_cents) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(p.paid_cents) END AS spend_cents
    FROM main.orders AS o
    JOIN main.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN order_payments AS p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
customer_rfm AS (
    SELECT customer_unique_id, order_count, spend_cents,
           -- Elapsed days from this customer's last purchase to the latest delivered purchase.
           JULIANDAY(MAX(last_purchase) OVER ()) - JULIANDAY(last_purchase) AS recency_days
    FROM customer_totals
),
scores AS (
    -- Score 1 covers the best 20%. Equal values share their cumulative percentile.
    SELECT customer_unique_id, order_count, spend_cents,
           CEIL(5 * CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY recency_days)) AS r,
           CEIL(5 * CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC)) AS f,
           CASE WHEN spend_cents IS NOT NULL THEN
               CEIL(5 * CUME_DIST() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY (spend_cents IS NULL) ORDER BY spend_cents DESC
               ))
           END AS m
    FROM customer_rfm
),
segmented AS (
    SELECT customer_unique_id, order_count, spend_cents,
           CASE
               WHEN r = 1 AND f + m BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
               WHEN r IN (4, 5) AND f + m BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Can''t Lose Them'
               WHEN r IN (4, 5) AND f + m BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
               WHEN r IN (4, 5) AND f + m BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
               WHEN r IN (2, 3) AND f + m BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
               WHEN r = 3 AND f + m BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
               WHEN r = 1 AND f + m BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
               WHEN (r = 1 AND f + m BETWEEN 5 AND 6)
                 OR (r = 2 AND f + m BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
               WHEN r = 1 AND f + m BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
               WHEN r = 2 AND f + m BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
               WHEN r = 3 AND f + m BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
           END AS rfm_segment
    FROM scores
)
SELECT rfm_segment, COUNT(*) AS customers, SUM(order_count) AS delivered_orders,
       SUM(spend_cents) / (100.0 * SUM(order_count)) AS segment_avg_sales_per_order
FROM segmented
GROUP BY rfm_segment
ORDER BY segment_avg_sales_per_order DESC
LIMIT -1
